subject: Kite Labs: customer story approval + logo usage & tracking terms
messages:
From: Sasha Patel <sasha@kitelabs.ai>
To: dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Jordan Kim <jk@kitelabs.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood spotlight draft + logo usage

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the interview last month — the draft case study you shared looks great and Jordan and I walked through it this morning. We're generally happy to be featured, but our legal team asked for two clarifications before we sign off:

1) We need to confirm how you will display any performance numbers (can we anonymize the volume buckets and only show percentage uplift?).
2) Logo usage: we can provide the SVG but need to see the placement and, if possible, adherence to our brand lockup (attached PDF).

I've attached our internal logo guidelines and a marked-up version of your draft (KB_CaseStudy_Draft_v2). Could you route this to your marketing and legal for sign-off? Ideally we'd aim to publish the week of Aug 16, but that timeline depends on legal.

Also, our legal asked about tracking pixels or analytics inside the published page — we are not comfortable with any 1P tracking and would prefer a simple view count metric provided by Redwood instead.

Can you confirm next steps?

Best,
Sasha
Sasha Patel
Head of Marketing, Kite Labs

From: dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@kitelabs.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood spotlight draft + logo usage

Thanks Sasha — appreciate the clear notes and the brand kit.

Quick answers while we loop people in:
- Performance numbers: we can publish percentage uplift only and replace absolute volumes with anonymized buckets (e.g., ">1M monthly tokens" -> ">1M tokens"). I'll get the case study team to update the language.
- Logo placement: understood. Marissa, Vanessa — please follow the attached Kite guidelines and produce a few mockups (header lockup, inline callout, and small badge).
- Tracking: Redwood will not deploy any tracking pixels. We can provide view counts and a simple engagement metric export (CSV) upon request. No embedded analytics.

Sasha — I'll coordinate with Kite Legal for the final redlines and circulate a clean version + DocuSign link when we have approvals.

Next: Marissa, can you take the draft and produce two placement mockups by EOD Friday? Vanessa, can you prepare the final external-facing short quote (1-2 lines) we'll use as a pull-quote?

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-02T10:06:00-07:00
Subject: internal: Kite Labs case study — logo placement & quote

[internal thread — short coordination]

Marissa / Vanessa, forwarding Sasha's notes and their brand kit (attached). Key constraints: no tracking pixels, anonymize absolute numbers, and Kite Legal will send redlines.

Marissa: please produce three mockups as discussed (page hero lockup, two-column feature callout, and 200px badge). Use the attached KB_CaseStudy_Draft.docx as source. Aim: first pass by 2026-08-06 EOD PST.

Vanessa: draft a 12-18 word pull quote that emphasizes lower latency and unit-cost savings; keep it vendor-positive but short. I want two variants: one technical, one customer-ops friendly.

I'll add legal when Kite sends redlines. Keep mocks in the shared Drive folder and ping me when ready for a review.

— Dylan

From: Kite Labs Legal <legal@kitelabs.ai>
To: dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com, Sasha Patel <sasha@kitelabs.ai>
Cc: Jordan Kim <jk@kitelabs.ai>
Date: 2026-08-04T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood spotlight draft + logo usage — redlines attached

Dylan / Sasha,

Attached are our redlines (redlines_kite_legal.docx). We are generally comfortable with the case study provided the following are agreed:

- No granular customer-identifiable data will be published. Performance figures should be expressed in percent uplift or anonymized buckets as proposed by Dylan.
- Logo usage: placement examples are acceptable; please ensure the SVG supplied is used without color alterations and the minimum clearspace in our guidelines is respected.
- Quote sign-off: Kite requires final approval of any quoted language. We will provide a signed confirmation via DocuSign once the quote is finalized.
- Analytics/tracking: we confirm we will not allow tracking pixels. Redwood may provide view/engagement counts as a CSV export after publication (no embedded trackers).

We have a standard permission form; please route the final PDF to the undersigned for signature. We attached a prefilled DocuSign packet at the following link: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/KiteSpotlight-v1

Provided these terms are incorporated, Kite Legal will sign off by 2026-08-06.

Regards,
Jordan Kim
Counsel, Kite Labs
legal@kitelabs.ai
